# Mangalam Coalfield Private Limited

> Mangalam Coalfield is a mine developer and operator reviving the historic Amlabad underground pits in the Eastern Jharia Area of District Bokaro, Jharkhand, India — producing coal and coal bed methane (CBM), with statutory safety and DGMS compliance at the core. This site also hosts a free, curated library of Indian coal-mining regulations.

## Regulations library (free, public reference)
A curated, searchable library of the regulations, circulars and codes that govern Indian coal mining — each with a plain-language summary, the official government source, and a downloadable copy. Covers: the Coal Mines Regulations 2017 (and amendments), the Mines Act 1952 and rules, DGMS technical/legislative circulars, the four Labour Codes (2020) and their rules, the MMDR Act with MCR/MCDR, environment and forest rules, CEA electrical regulations, and Ministry of Coal guidelines.

- Mangalam Regulation Desk (also at https://regs.mangalamcoal.com): https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations
- Search every Act, rule, regulation and DGMS circular, provision by provision: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/search
- Full text of each Act/Rules/Regulations, one anchor per provision: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/<slug>/text
- Each DGMS circular on its own page: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/circulars/<id>
- Concordances (where each provision of an old instrument goes in its replacement, with a word-level comparison), all at https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/concordance :
  - CMR 2017 → Draft OSH&WC (Coal Mines) Regulations 2026: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/concordance/cmr-2017-draft-2026
  - Mines Rules 1955 → OSH&WC (Central) Rules 2026: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/concordance/mines-rules-1955-oshwc-central-rules-2026
  - Mines Vocational Training Rules 1966 → OSH&WC (Central) Rules 2026: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/concordance/mvtr-1966-oshwc-central-rules-2026
  - CEA Safety Regulations 2010 → 2023: https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/concordance/cea-2010-cea-2023
- Individual regulations have their own pages at https://mangalamcoal.com/regulations/<slug>

## Knowledge hub (how coal mining works)
Plain-language explainers on Indian coal mining — engineering (bord & pillar), safety and ventilation, regulation (DGMS), and markets (the National Coal Index).
- https://mangalamcoal.com/learn
